metadata.title: Gritty Lo-Fi Indie Rock Album Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A lo-fi, candid photographic style featuring subjects in motion against a textured cyan wall, framed by thick black borders and distressed typewriter-style typography.
triggerTerms: distressed typewriter font on black border

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic window framed by thick black horizontal bands. The photo depicts two figures in casual, candid poses against a vibrant but weathered cyan wooden wall. The overall mood is raw, unpolished, and evocative of 1980s alternative music culture.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the vibrant cyan background and the heavy black framing borders
Dynamic tension between the two figures, one in profile and one facing forward but looking down
Textural harmony between the wood grain of the wall and the film grain of the image
Asymmetrical typographic placement balancing the top-left and bottom-right corners
coreInvariants: Thick black horizontal bars at the top and bottom
A single small red graphic element used as a separator

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures occupy the left and right thirds of the central frame, scaled to show from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central cyan wall acts as a high-contrast anchor for the darker figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left text, down through the leaning figure on the left, across to the standing figure on the right, and finishes at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black bars provide significant negative space, compressing the photographic action into a letterbox format.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan tones contrasted against deep, crushed blacks in the shadows and borders.

letterConstructionRules: Varying baseline heights for individual characters
Eroded edges suggesting a physical stamp or old typewriter
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'd' with a slightly curved ascender
Lowercase 'b' with a heavy, rounded bowl

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed entirely within the black border area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two locations to create diagonal balance.
graphicDevices: Small red cross-like icon used as a glyph separator

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the authentic distressed typewriter look with ink-splatter details.
Provides the correct slab-serif skeleton but requires manual distressing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, lo-fi photo of two men in casual 80s attire (plaid shirt, dark jacket) standing against a textured cyan wooden wall. Frame the image with thick black bars at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white distressed typewriter-style lowercase text in the top-left and bottom-right corners of the black bars. Insert a small red icon between the words in the top-left.

verificationChecks: Is the cyan wall textured and vibrant?
Are the black borders thick and solid?
Is the text lowercase and visibly distressed?
Is there a small red accent in the top text?

adjustableVariables: Wall color (can be swapped for mustard or olive while maintaining lo-fi feel)
Subject poses (can be any candid, non-posed movement)
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific 'david+david' or 'boomtown' wording
Ensure the red icon is a generic shape, not a specific logo
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is placed inside black borders
Ensure the cyan wall has visible wood grain or texture
Confirm the red accent is small and centered in the top text
recipe.reuseFormula: Lo-fi Candid Photo + Cyan Texture + Black Letterbox + Distressed Typewriter Text = Indie Rock Aesthetic
